Romanesque-cathedral-castle register — squat round towers flanking a barrel-vaulted nave-keep, painted interior frescoes visible through arrow-slit windows, monastic-fortress mood of grim piety.
Norman-Crusader fortress register — massive rusticated stonework, projecting machicolation galleries, narrow slit windows cut deep, brutal pragmatic mood of an uncompromising military occupation.

Tolkien-Elvish-Rivendell register — organic curved stonework grown rather than built, slender arched bridges spanning waterfall-cut ravines, luminous serene mood of timeless woodland grace.

Late-Medieval Tudor hybrid register — half-timbered upper stories corbelled over dressed-stone lower courses, oriel windows projecting outward, ornate carved-beam facades, prosperous domestic-fortress mood.

Renaissance-fairytale Neuschwanstein register — slender ornate spires clustered above white-plastered towers, decorative crenellation purely romantic, arched loggia colonnades, dreaming theatrical mood of illustrated-storybook fantasy.

Byzantine-fortress eastern register — gold-mosaic-clad keep walls blazing at dawn, rounded domes atop garrison towers, iconostasis-painted interior gate-chapel, opulent defended-sanctuary mood of sacred empire.

Mont-Saint-Michel monastery-castle register — tidal-rock outcrop rising sheer from the sea, ascending rings of abbey walls climbing to a needle spire, isolated sublime mood of heaven-reaching isolation.
